devdoc.details: Supports both automatic routing to the active recipient or manual routing by operators.      Access is controlled via roles:      - DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE: manages role assignments      - ROUTER_ADMIN_ROLE: can add/remove route recipients      - ROUTER_OPERATOR_ROLE: can change active recipient, enable/disable auto-route, or manually route assets

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

params.recipient: The address receiving the routed assets

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params.recipient: The address of the recipient added
The address of the recipient removed

params.enabled: True if auto-routing is enabled, false otherwise

params._recipient: The address to add as a route recipient.

params._active: The active recipient address for auto-routing.
params._recipients: Initial list of valid route recipients.

getActiveRecipient().details: Returns the currently active route recipient where assets are routed automatically.

returns.activeRecipient_: The address of the active route recipient.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRouteRecipients().details: Returns the full list of route recipients currently registered in the router.

returns.routeRecipients_: The array of all registered recipient addresses.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

isAutoRouteEnabled().details: Indicates whether automatic routing is currently enabled.

returns.enabled_: Boolean flag, true if auto-routing is enabled, false otherwise.

isRouteRecipient(address).details: Checks if a given address is a registered route recipient.

returns._0: True if the address is a valid route recipient, otherwise false.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to transfer.
params._token: The ERC20 token address to route.

removeRouteRecipient(address).details: Cannot remove the currently active recipient.

params._recipient: The address to remove from the recipients list.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

route(address,uint256).details: Pulls tokens from msg.sender into this contract.      If auto-route is enabled, immediately forwards them to `_activeRecipient`.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to transfer.
params._token: The ERC20 token address being routed.

params._active: The address to set as the active recipient.

params._enabled: Boolean flag to set auto-routing state.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

ROUTER_ADMIN_ROLE.details: Only addresses with this role can call `addRouteRecipient` and `removeRouteRecipient`Calculated as keccak256("ROUTER_ADMIN_ROLE").

ROUTER_OPERATOR_ROLE.details: Only addresses with this role can call `setActiveRecipient`, `setAutoRouteEnabled` and `manualRoute`Calculated as keccak256("ROUTER_OPERATOR_ROLE").

_activeRecipient.details: The currently active recipient address where tokens are routed automatically.

_isAutoRouteEnabled.details: Flag indicating whether automatic routing is enabled.

_isRouteRecipient.details: Mapping for quick lookup of approved recipients.

AutoRouteEnabled().notice: Thrown when attempting to manual route the asstes when auto route is enabled.

InvalidRouteEnabledStatus().notice: Thrown when attempting to set auto-route to its current state.

NotRouterRecipient().notice: Thrown when a non-registered recipient is used.

RecipientAlreadyAdded().notice: Thrown when a recipient is already added.

RecipientAlreadyRemoved().notice: Thrown when a recipient is already removed.

RemoveActiveRouter().notice: Thrown when attempting to remove the currently active recipient.

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when a provided address is zero.

ZeroAmount().notice: Thrown when a provided amount is zero.

AssetsReceived(address,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when assets are received by the contract

AssetsRouted(address,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when assets are routed to a recipient

RouteRecipientAdded(address).notice: Emitted when a new route recipient is added

RouteRecipientRemoved(address).notice: Emitted when a route recipient is removed

SetActiveRecipient(address).notice: Emitted when the active recipient is changed

SetAutoRouteEnabled(bool).notice: Emitted when auto-routing is enabled or disabled

ROUTER_ADMIN_ROLE().notice: Role identifier for router admins (manage recipients list).

ROUTER_OPERATOR_ROLE().notice: Role identifier for router operators (manage routing settings).

addRouteRecipient(address).notice: Add a new valid route recipient.

getActiveRecipient().notice: Returns the currently active route recipient.

getRouteRecipients().notice: Returns the list of approved route recipients.

isRouteRecipient(address).notice: Checks if an address is a valid route recipient.

manualRoute(address,address,uint256).notice: Manually route tokens to a specified recipient.

route(address,uint256).notice: Deposit tokens into the router and optionally forward them to the active recipient.

setActiveRecipient(address).notice: Set the active recipient for auto-routing.

userdoc.notice: Routes incoming ERC20 token transfers to a designated recipient address.
